candidates.description: This feature vector activates on words related to acquiring, adding, or gaining things, entities, or access.
This vector is related to artistic decoration, ornamentation, and sculpted or adorned objects.
This feature vector activates on concepts, locations, and terminology related to museums, art galleries, and historical exhibitions.
This feature vector represents the creation, collection, and categorization of tangible human art, artifacts, and historical objects.
This feature vector represents the concept of showing, displaying, or exhibiting things.
This feature represents the concept of renewal, restoration, or making things new again.
This vector represents verbs and adjectives denoting change, modification, or fluctuation in magnitude, state, or rate.
This feature vector represents architectural elements, spaces, and transitions within a building.
This vector represents the concept of visual and fine arts, encompassing creative works, artists, and cultural artifacts.
This vector activates for words related to physical movement, displacement, or the transfer of objects and entities from one location or status to another.
